plan.goal: Make MemoryTransport peer closure, errors, draining and lease ownership deterministic for Session.
acceptance: Implement the exact TransportState and TransportError values and invariant from the frozen contract.
Propagate peer-visible close and symmetrically detach/drain on every terminal pair transition.
Preserve transfer-first lease ownership and distinguish invalid unreliable inputs from normal lossy rejection.
Document single-thread affinity and the intentional FaultReason compatibility break.
Pass the full frozen transition/alias matrix without touching schema/session/replication or asmdefs.

execution.handoff: MemoryTransport now exposes deterministic peer close/error state and drains/detaches both endpoints with transfer-safe ownership.
validationEvidence: Focused transport lifecycle and lease matrix: 10 passed, 0 failed
Exact two-file ownership, git diff --check and lemmings check --all passed
Deferred integration gate: Unity EditMode unigame.staticecs.network.tests

riskToTest.risk: A stopped peer remains Connected and Session waits forever
riskToTest.test: Connected Dispose immediately yields peer Closed/RemoteClosed and drains both queues

riskToTest.risk: Terminal or rejected sends leak or double-return packet storage
riskToTest.test: Alias invalidation matrix for Closed/Faulted/Disposed, overflow, invalid and stale sends

riskToTest.risk: Normal snapshot loss becomes a terminal transport error
riskToTest.test: Stale/equal/capacity rejection remains Connected/None and preserves accepted latest state
